description:
Paper2Arm 5135
	

Paper2Arm 5135 evaluates whether an Agent can turn a materials-science paper reproduction
objective into code, calculation inputs, analysis procedures, and structured research outputs.
The release contains 5,135 distinct (workflow_id, task_id) task instances across 975 workflow
families. A paper may support more than one workflow; such instances have different instructions
and are intentionally retained.
The source papers and publisher figures are not distributed.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MatMaster-DP/Paper2Arm-5135.
